name: code-over-ssh
description: Open files in your local VS Code from a client running on the SSH remote host — for example straight from a VNC session.

code_over_ssh.restrictToWorkspace.markdownDescription: Only allow opening files that live inside the current workspace folders (paths are resolved through symlinks). When `false`, any existing regular file readable by the user may be opened.

code_over_ssh.notifyOnOpen.markdownDescription: Show an information message when a file is opened via the `cosh` client.

code_over_ssh.stateDir.description: Override the state directory (sockets, token, host registry). Defaults to $HOME/.code_over_ssh on the machine where this extension host runs.
